data.name: Aqlimah
data.gender_notes: Aqlimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aql' which means intellect or understanding, Aqlimah is a feminine name that signifies a wise and knowledgeable companion or guide. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) described a true believer as a guide to others and a companion in the Hereafter. This name is a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in leading a righteous life and helping others find their way to the truth.
data.spiritual_meaning: A companion on the spiritual journey
data.etymology: Aqlimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqlimah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عقليمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عقل، تعني الشخصية الحكيمة و العاقلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عقليمة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ق-ل' والذي يعني الفهم و الحكمة. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية العاقلة و الحكيمة التي تتسم بالفهم العميق و القدرة على الاستنتاج الصحيح. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة الآية 282 'و ليستعقدوا شهادة ويستوعظوا إن كانوا على ذلك' حيث يشير إلى أهمية العقل في فهم الشهادة و الحقائق.

in_urdu.name: عقلیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: عقل سے متعلق، حکیما، عقلمند شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقلیمہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ق-ل' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حکمت اور سمجھ. یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو عقلمند، فہمیدہ اور حکیمانہ سوچ رکھتی ہیں. جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام علم، حکمت اور عقل کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अक़लीमा
in_hindi.meaning: अक़ल से जुड़ा, बुद्धिमान, समझदार व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़लीमा नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-ق-ل' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धि और समझ. यह नाम उन व्यक्तित्वों को संबोधित करता है जो बुद्धिमान, समझदार और विवेकपूर्ण सोच रखते हैं. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम ज्ञान, बुद्धि और विवेक के महत्व को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: عقلېمه
in_pashto.meaning: د عقل څخه مشتق، حکیم، عاقل شخصیت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقلېمه نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-ق-ل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د حکمت او پوهې دي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې عاقل، حکیم او پوه شخصیت لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د عقل، حکمت او پوهې ارزښت ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Aqlimah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic 'aql', meaning wise, intelligent, or discerning personality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aqlimah originates from the Arabic root 'a-q-l', which signifies wisdom, understanding, and intellect. This name addresses personalities that are wise, intelligent, and possess a discerning nature. In Islamic tradition, the name Aqlimah reflects the importance of intellect, wisdom, and rational thinking. The Quran mentions the term 'aql' in various verses, emphasizing the role of reason in comprehending faith and reality.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Sa'd, Al-Tabaqat Al-Kubra, Volume 3, Page 119-120 The name Aqlimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aqlimah bint Abi Al-Harith was the wife of the third caliph, Uthman ibn Affan. She was a sister of Abu Musa Al-Ashari, who was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. Aqlimah was known for her piety and generosity. During the first civil war of Islam, she played a crucial role in securing Uthman's election as caliph by providing support and reassurance to the Arab tribes. After Uthman's assassination, she was one of the few women who were allowed to stay in the Prophet's Mosque during the siege of Medina by the rebels. She was later killed during the battle.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri, Ansab Al-Ashraf, Volume 3, Page 126-127 The name Aqlimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aqlimah bint Al-Harith Al-Kalbi was a prominent woman of the Banu Kalb tribe who lived during the Abbasid Caliphate. She was a patron of scholars and poets and was known for her beauty and generosity. She was married to several notable men, including Al-Harith ibn Surayj Al-Kalbi, the governor of Kufa, and Al-Hasan ibn Al-Fadl, a grandson of the sixth caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib. Aqlimah was also the mother of the famous poet, Al-Mutanabbi. She was a major player in the political and cultural scene of her time and was known to have influenced several important decisions made by the Abbasid Caliphs.

The term has gained significant traction on social media platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest, where fashion influencers, bloggers, and designers showcase their stylish and modest outfits that cater to a growing demand for Islamic and halal fashion. Aqlimah fashion is characterized by its focus on covering the body while still being trendy and stylish. It often includes the use of traditional Islamic clothing such as the abaya, hijab, and jilbab, as well as contemporary Western designs that adhere to Islamic dress codes. The trend towards Aqlimah fashion reflects the desire of many Muslims to practice their faith in a modern and fashionable way, while also staying true to their cultural and religious values.
